title: Focal 0.1.0 · UX Alpha 6

qa.core_execution: cached results for unchanged core source
qa.unsigned_release_build: passed; not the instrumented or published APK
qa.build_seconds_note: Gradle reported 3m 57s; build wall time is not app performance.

targeted_regressions.scope: Live append/manual reading/restoration, modal suspension and long/final passages, viewport reflow/resize, and date filtering while retaining search/review and navigation. Original oversized draft and transactional assertions retained. The active-draft test now awaits live content and Resume instead of the deliberately removed title. Search persistence compares exact characters separately from annotation metadata, preserving exact caret and focus assertions. A deterministic regression checks off-main storage reads and Main publication of both success and error states.

manual.scope: Synthetic notes, day filter and navigation at 411x890dp; settings in light/dark, 200% font and actual landscape; active draft recreation/notification video; reduced-motion date/note/copy checks. Final opaque content during 160 ms / 8 dp page transitions inspected frame by frame; one note opening briefly shows the normal loading indicator during its asynchronous read; public note/settings captures match the exact full-QA APK. Earlier large-font/dark/reduced-motion checks preceded page alpha removal and the IO/Main publication boundary; their layouts are unchanged.
manual.audio: Emulator host audio disabled; no audible playback or microphone claim.

independent_review: Astra critical source and actual static/motion/reduced-motion review
not_established: Physical Pixel 10 microphone, audible playback and installation
Phone background reliability, battery, thermals and ARM latency
Seven-language accuracy/speed improvement, mixed-language terms and varying-noise hallucination fix
Local language-model correction accuracy and reversible correction UX
Stable production signing and release-variant runtime validation
Owner acceptance of the updated interface
iteration_notes: Initial focused date failure identified four pixels of previous-day content padding; firstVisibleItemIndex fixes the header. A new test selector was narrowed to the filter rather than its identically labelled row. First full run 106/107 had one failure at an obsolete live-title readiness guard; the unchanged draft/notification assertions passed after awaiting live content. Second full run intentionally interrupted for the frame-review alpha-zero correction, not counted as passing. Another attempt ended with host exit 143 and no summary; the cause is unknown. Its earlier search check failed whole AnnotatedString equality although printed characters and caret matched. Original diagnostics passed 1 and 12 tests without reproducing metadata; the revised check retains exact characters, caret, focus and navigation independently of decoration. A subsequent full run 106/107 failed through the Compose test frame clock after IO library publication. Storage reads now remain on IO and success/error state publication runs on Main. The deterministic thread contract failed on the old app and passed with the same test APK on the new app; all 9 focused ViewModel/action checks passed in 8.624s JUnit. This does not reproduce the rare test-clock interleaving or establish a phone crash. The final full run is the clean result above. All earlier diagnostics retained privately.
